title: Blue Monday: Suggestions for Managing Difficult Days
teaser: We all have difficult days, sometimes a difficult week. I shared some suggestions with Belfast Live on how to manage stress and stay positive through the darker days of winter.

title: Eat the Frog: Tackling the Hardest Thing First
teaser: An article I wrote for the Counselling Directory on procrastination, avoidance and the simple discipline of doing the hardest thing first, and why it lifts the rest of your day.
